text: The Stone Font asks stone to stay. Give it Pulse and the right shape around it, and it fills itself with cobblestone, then stone, then obsidian.
Unbraced cobble is cheap enough to run on a hand-played [Drumheart](drumheart), so this is the first pattern most camps build.

pages.title: Cobble: the font and four marks
pages.text: Draw a chalk mark on each side of the font, on the same floor.

pages.title: Cobble
text: With its four marks and a Drumheart within **8 blocks**, the font makes **one cobblestone every 2 seconds** at **4 Pulse a second**. No voice is needed.
Its slots are output only: do not hopper cobble in, the font makes its own. Take the output by hand, with a hopper, or with a relay.
Font cobble is for building and for hammering into gravel and sand. Echo Shatter makes Echo Shards only from stone, not cobble, and stone is what the next tier makes.

pages.title: Stone and obsidian: brace it
pages.text: Keep the four marks and add an Anchor Stone at each corner of a 5x5 around the font.

pages.title: Stone
text: Braced, and with the **Earth** voice in reach, the font makes **stone every 3 seconds** at **32 Pulse a second**. That stone is exactly what Echo Shatter turns into Echo Shards.
The Earth totem has to be kept awake (see [Keeping](keeping)): while it is dim each stone takes about 30% longer, and once it is quiet the stone stops. Cobble never needs Earth.

pages.title: Obsidian
text: Obsidian needs the brace and Earth, plus one of two things:
- **Fire and Water** voices both in reach: obsidian every **12 seconds** at **48 Pulse a second**.
- Or pipe in **250 mB of water and 250 mB of lava** for each block: the same obsidian at only **12 Pulse a second**. The font holds up to 4,000 mB of each.
Piping into an unbraced font does nothing. If Fire and Water are both present, the font uses the voices and leaves its tanks alone.

pages.title: Depth and ranks
text: Below **y 0** the font gives the deepslate of each tier instead: cobbled deepslate, then deepslate. Obsidian stays obsidian.
Rank the font like any other workshop: faster asks, more Pulse a second.

pages.title: Reading the font
text: A comparator against the font reads how far it is through the block it is making, and drops to 0 while it waits for anything.
If the font sits idle, crouch and right-click it with this book. It names missing marks, anchors and voices.
